pages.text: When they opened the window that morning, everything was white. They couldn't see the canal or the bridge.
"We said we'd go to Grandpa Goose's today." Pongi put on her shoes.
They walked into the fog. They stepped on a cracked stone along the way.
"I know this path with my eyes closed." Dad led the way.
Dad turned left. Pongi followed behind.
Pongi asked, "Dad, didn't we pass this way already?"
"No. This is somewhere else." Dad turned left again.
The cracked stone was beneath their feet again.
The fog lifted a little. A door appeared in front of them.
It was the door to Pongi's house. "Dad, this is our house."
